regions.today: It will be dry for many this evening, apart from an odd patch of rain in some northern parts. Some bright or sunny spells are possible too. All in light to moderate westerly winds, easing later.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be generally dry with clear spells and a few isolated showers. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees, with a light to moderate southwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be mostly dry to begin with sunny spells. However, it will become cloudier with scattered outbreaks of rain and drizzle moving eastwards. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees, with a light to moderate southwesterly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Tuesday and Wednesday.
